title: National Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme 2026-27
text:
MINISTRY OF SOCIAL EMPOWERMENT
NATIONAL POST-MATRIC SCHOLARSHIP 2026

Eligible Students: All undergraduate degree students with family income under 2.5 LPA.
Application Deadline: 30 November 2026.
Required Documents: Income certificate, Caste certificate, Class 12 marksheet.
Application Fee: Zero fee (Free of cost).
Official Portal: https://scholarships.gov.in

title: Autonomous Engineering College Semester IV Exam Schedule
text:
CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS - GOVERNMENT ENGINEERING COLLEGE
NOTICE: B.Tech Sem IV Regular Examinations

Registration Deadline: 25 November 2026.
Examination Fee: INR 1200 per semester payable at college accounts desk.
Attendance Eligibility: Minimum 75% attendance mandatory.
Exam begins 15 December 2026.

title: Municipal Corporation Free Health & Eye Checkup Camp
text:
CIVIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT - PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT
Community Eye Screening Camp

All senior citizens and residents are invited to free eye checkup camp at Community Hall, Ward 12 from 05 Nov to 10 Nov 2026 daily 9 AM to 1 PM.
No fees, no documents required.

title: Faculty Research Innovation Grant (Ambiguous Timeline)
text:
DEAN OF RESEARCH - INNOVATION SEED GRANT 2026

Inviting mini-grant proposals from junior faculty members.
Application Deadline: Proposals must be submitted tentatively before winter recess.
Required Documents: Project abstract, itemized budget, HOD endorsement letter.

title: State University Merit Admission Round 2
text:
DIRECTORATE OF ADMISSIONS - MERIT ROUND 2 SEAT ALLOTMENT

Eligibility: Candidates with state entrance rank between 5001 and 12000.
Reporting Deadline: 18 November 2026 (5:00 PM).
Required Documents: Seat allotment letter, original 10th & 12th certificates, transfer certificate.
Counseling Fee: INR 2000 (Non-refundable).

title: Campus Placement Drive: CloudCore Technologies
text:
TRAINING AND PLACEMENT CELL
CAMPUS RECRUITMENT NOTICE: CloudCore Technologies

Eligibility: Final year B.Tech CSE and IT students with CGPA 7.0 and above with no active backlogs.
Resume Submission Deadline: 08 November 2026 (11:59 PM).
Required Documents: Updated resume (PDF), college ID card copy.

title: University Central Library Annual Clearance and Book Return
text:
CENTRAL LIBRARY CIRCULAR
SUBJECT: Return of Borrowed Books and Overdue Fine Settlement

All students must return all borrowed books on or before: 30 November 2026.
Overdue Fine: INR 5 per day per overdue volume after cutoff.
Clearance certificates will be issued upon return.

title: Men and Women Senior Hostel Room Re-Allotment (Winter 2026)
text:
CHIEF WARDEN OFFICE - HOSTEL RE-ALLOTMENT CIRCULAR

Eligibility: Enrolled hostel boarders of 2nd and 3rd year.
Submission Deadline: 12 November 2026.
Hostel Mess & Caution Deposit: INR 18000 per semester.
Documents: Previous fee receipt, parent consent declaration.

title: Annual Inter-College Cultural Festival 'TARANG 2026'
text:
STUDENT ACTIVITY COUNCIL - TARANG 2026

Auditions for music, dance, and dramatics teams will be held on 15 November 2026 at Main Auditorium.
Registration Deadline: 10 November 2026.
No entry fees for bona fide university students.

title: Public Health Advisory: Seasonal Flu Vaccination Drive
text:
STATE HEALTH MISSION - PUBLIC ADVISORY
Influenza Vaccination Program for High-Risk Groups

Vaccinations available at all district general hospitals during regular outpatient clinic hours.
Free for pregnant women and elderly citizens aged 65 and above.
No prior online registration needed.

title: National Technical Symposium: Call for Student Research Papers
text:
DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING
CALL FOR PAPERS: INNOTECH 2026

Submission Deadline: 22 November 2026.
Registration Fee: INR 500 per accepted paper presentation.
Required Documents: 4-page IEEE format manuscript, student identity proof.

title: Duplicate Student Identity Card Replacement Circular
text:
ACADEMIC SECTION NOTICE
PROCEDURE FOR ISSUING DUPLICATE ID CARD

Students who have misplaced their campus identity badge must submit: copy of police general diary entry, one passport size photograph, and fee receipt of INR 250 paid at counter 4.
Applications processed on rolling basis throughout working days.

title: Ph.D. Open Oral Defense & Viva-Voce Examination Notice
text:
OFFICE OF DEAN ACADEMIC AFFAIRS
PH.D. ORAL DEFENSE NOTICE

Candidate: Ms. Ananya Sharma (Enrollment: PH22CS014)
Title: Explainable AI in Public Healthcare Delivery
Date and Time: 14 November 2026 at 11:00 AM (Seminar Hall 2).
Open to all interested scholars and faculty members.

title: Weekend Certificate Course in Data Analytics & Machine Learning
text:
CENTRE FOR CONTINUING EDUCATION
CERTIFICATE PROGRAM IN DATA ANALYTICS (BATCH 4)

Eligibility: Working professionals or students with basic Python knowledge.
Application Deadline: 28 November 2026.
Course Fee: INR 7500 payable in single installment.
Required Documents: Graduation certificate, photo ID.

title: District Welfare Board: Senior Citizen Subsidy Distribution
text:
DISTRICT SOCIAL WELFARE OFFICE
PUBLIC WELFARE CIRCULAR NO 19/2026

Assistance allowance for senior citizens living below poverty line.
Submission Deadline: 20 December 2026 at Taluk Office.
Required Documents: Age proof certificate, BPL ration card, active bank passbook copy.
No application charge.
